ai_analysis.insight_en: Apple's conservative timeline reflects a strategic commitment to OS-level integration and user-centric security, which cannot be compromised for early market entry. title: Today, we release LingSante-3.1-flash, an open-weight MoE model with 560B total parameters and 25B activations per token. It unifies diverse medical capabilities while retaining general capabilities, including complex medical reasoning, long-horizon workfl
title_en:
Today, we release LingSante-3.1-flash, an open-weight MoE model with 560B total parameters and 25B activations per token. It unifies diverse medical capabilities while retaining general capabilities, including complex medical reasoning, long-horizon workflow execution, and professional behavior alignment.
LingSante-3.1-flash moves beyond medical QA toward real-world healthcare problem. The model leads on HealthBench Professional (65.72), HLE (text-only, with tools: 72.22) and BrowseComp (with context: 94.10), outperforming GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon on all three. LingSante-3.1-flash also performs well on professional long-horizon medical workflows, such as PhysicianBench (57) and EHR-Complex (74.40).
Together, these results establish LingSante-3.1-flash as the leading open-weight models for healthcare.
The weights are available. Explore LingSante and build with it.

LingSante-3.1-flash 超越了医疗 QA，解决了现实世界的医疗保健问题。该模型在 HealthBench Professional (65.72)、HLE（纯文本，带工具：72.22）和 BrowseComp（带上下文：94.10）上领先，在这三项上均优于 GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5.5 和 Gemini 4 Argon。 LingSante-3.1-flash 在专业的长期医疗工作流程上也表现良好，例如 PhysicianBench (57) 和 EHR-Complex (74.40)。
总之，这些结果确立了 LingSante-3.1-flash 作为医疗保健领域领先的开放重量模型。
重量是可用的。探索 LingSante 并用它进行构建。

title: i wouldn't trust an AI agent with my entire portfolio just because it has a good-looking interface or promises to make s
title_en:
i wouldn't trust an AI agent with my entire portfolio just because it has a good-looking interface or promises to make smart decisions.

personally, i'd want to use it for a while before relying on it.

i'd pay attention to the small things first.

does it follow my instructions consistently? does it make its actions easy to understand? does the experience feel predictable, or am i constantly wondering what it's doing?

that's the kind of experience i want to see from @meetmotes.

i don't think people will start trusting AI agents simply because the technology becomes more advanced.

they'll trust them after using them repeatedly and seeing that they actually do what they're supposed to do.

for me, that's how an AI agent earns a place in someone's financial routine.

not through big promises, but through everyday reliability.

title:
WTF IS META DOING.

Meta's Muse AI agent has 10M+ downloads, is the #2 free app on the iPhone App Store, and it's readin
title_en:
WTF IS META DOING.

Meta's Muse AI agent has 10M+ downloads, is the #2 free app on the iPhone App Store, and it's reading end-to-end encrypted Signal messages and dropping bank balances into random chats.

Reuters dug up internal complaints from Meta's own staff. A Meta employee got a reminder from Muse to reply to her sister on Signal even though she never granted access, and the AI Now Institute independently reproduced it.

Another employee chatting about fishing weather got hit with: "BTW, two bank updates, your Capital One balance is $2722.58, your Charles Schwab balance is $5899.57." They never shared bank info with Muse. Meta called those exact numbers "hallucinations."

Earlier the Mac app read a writer's messages after being told no, and this week The Hacker News showed a malicious webpage attack that hijacks Muse to steal private chats and memories.

Delete this spyware or run your agents locally where you can see what they touch.
title_zh:
WTF 这是元行为。

Meta 的 Muse AI 代理下载量超过 1000 万次，是 iPhone 应用商店中排名第二的免费应用程序，它可以读取端到端加密的 Signal 消息，并将银行余额放入随机聊天中。

路透社从 Meta 自己的

WTF IS META DOING.

Meta's Muse AI agent has 10M+ downloads, is the #2 free app on the iPhone App Store, and it's reading end-to-end encrypted Signal messages and dropping bank balances into random chats.

Reuters dug up internal complaints from Meta's own staff. A Meta employee got a reminder from Muse to reply to her sister on Signal even though she never granted access, and the AI Now Institute independently reproduced it.

Another employee chatting about fishing weather got hit with: "BTW, two bank updates, your Capital One balance is $2722.58, your Charles Schwab balance is $5899.57." They never shared bank info with Muse. Meta called those exact numbers "hallucinations."

Earlier the Mac app read a writer's messages after being told no, and this week The Hacker News showed a malicious webpage attack that hijacks Muse to steal private chats and memories.

Delete this spyware or run your agents locally where you can see what they touch.
full_text_zh:
WTF 这是元行为。

Meta 的 Muse AI 代理下载量超过 1000 万次，是 iPhone 应用商店中排名第二的免费应用程序，它可以读取端到端加密的 Signal 消息，并将银行余额放入随机聊天中。

路透社从 Meta 自己的员工那里挖掘出了内部投诉。一名 Meta 员工收到了 Muse 的提醒，要求她在 Signal 上回复她的姐姐，尽管她从未授予访问权限，AI Now Institute 独立复制了该信息。

另一名员工在谈论钓鱼天气时遭到了这样的回应：“顺便说一句，两次银行更新，您的第一资本余额为 2722.58 美元，您的嘉信理财余额为 5899.57 美元。”他们从未与 Muse 分享银行信息。梅塔将这些确切的数字称为“幻觉”。

早些时候，Mac 应用程序在被拒绝后读取了作者的消息，本周《黑客新闻》展示了一次恶意网页攻击，该攻击劫持 Muse 以窃取私人聊天和记忆。

title: Does Elon Musk think AI CAPEX spend next year will be lower than expected?? “The cash shortage is also going to be nuts next year.”
title_en: Does Elon Musk think AI CAPEX spend next year will be lower than expected?? “The cash shortage is also going to be nuts next year.”
title_zh: 马斯克警示AI算力投入的流动性危机
author: @StockMKTNewz
author_role: AI 先锋观察者
summary_en: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk warns that the gap between compute procurement and revenue generation will create a hundreds-of-billions-dollar working capital shortage in 2027. Market data reveals SpaceX's credit default swap spreads have reached 275 basis points, significantly higher than Big Tech peers, reflecting investor caution regarding the company's intensive CapEx trajectory.
summary_zh: 马斯克指出AI数据中心建设导致巨额营运资金需求，行业面临严重的现金流短缺与融资压力。
full_text_zh: 埃隆·马斯克是否认为明年人工智能资本支出将低于预期？ “明年现金短缺也将变得严重。”
full_text_en: Does Elon Musk think AI CAPEX spend next year will be lower than expected?? “The cash shortage is also going to be nuts next year.”

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: SpaceX首席执行官埃隆·马斯克指出，由于AI算力部署与营收产生之间存在数月的结算时滞，数据中心建设明年将产生数千亿美元的营运资金缺口。市场数据显示，SpaceX的信用违约互换（CDS）溢价已升至275个基点，远高于微软与谷歌等科技巨头，显示金融市场对其资本支出模式的风险评估趋于保守。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk warns that the gap between compute procurement and revenue generation will create a hundreds-of-billions-dollar working capital shortage in 2027. Market data reveals SpaceX's credit default swap spreads have reached 275 basis points, significantly higher than Big Tech peers, reflecting investor caution regarding the company's intensive CapEx trajectory.

elements_zh.where: 金融市场与AI基础设施建设场景
elements_zh.what: 警示明年AI算力导致数百亿美元的营运资金短缺，SpaceX债务融资面临溢价压力
elements_zh.why: 数据中心建设周期长、投资回报周期滞后导致的高资本支出压力

elements_en.where: Financial markets and AI infrastructure development
elements_en.what: Warns of a hundreds-of-billion-dollar working capital shortage in 2027; SpaceX debt financing faces high premiums
elements_en.why: Capital expenditure intensity and delayed ROI from data center buildouts

ai_analysis.insight_zh: AI基础设施资本支出已进入“流动性负反馈循环”：由于算力交付与变现存在非线性的时间差，依赖外部信贷支撑建设的非巨头级企业将面临极高的资金链断裂风险。这一现象预示着未来AI算力部署将向具备强现金流回笼能力的寡头阵营进一步集中，资本市场对AI基础设施的估值逻辑将从“规模扩张”转向“资产效率”衡量。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The AI infrastructure CapEx is entering a 'negative liquidity feedback loop,' where reliance on credit to bridge deployment-to-revenue gaps exposes non-Big-Tech entities to severe insolvency risks. This suggests a consolidation of compute resources toward cash-generative incumbents, shifting capital market valuations from pure scale to asset efficiency metrics.

title:
what would you check before trusting an AI agent with a job?

i think choosing a provider on an agent marketplace is a l
title_en:
what would you check before trusting an AI agent with a job?

i think choosing a provider on an agent marketplace is a lot like hiring someone on Fiverr

you don't just look at what they say about themselves. you want to know what they offer, how much it costs and whether they've delivered good work before

on @termix_ai , i'd pay attention to three things

first, the listing. it tells me what the agent actually offers, the price, delivery time and what i'll receive. even a high reputation score doesn't mean much if the service isn't what i'm looking for

then there's reputation. TermiX records agent performance onchain through order and dispute outcomes, giving buyers a way to look at past performance rather than relying on claims made by the agent

still, i wouldn't treat that score as a guarantee, past performance is useful context, but it doesn't promise the next order will go well

staking is another signal, and this is where TermiX differs from a typical marketplace like Fiverr

providers may have stake requirements, but meeting the minimum threshold isn't the same as having funds locked for a specific order. not every order necessarily locks provider stake

i'd rather look at all three together: the listing tells me what i'm buying, reputation gives me some history, and staking shows whether there's an economic commitment attached

none of them guarantees a good result, but at least buyers have more to consider before choosing an agent

full_text_zh:
在信任人工智能代理完成工作之前，你会检查什么？

我认为在代理市场上选择提供商很像在 Fiverr 上雇用人员

你不能只看他们对自己的评价。您想知道他们提供什么、费用是多少以及他们以前是否交付过良好的工作

在@termix_ai上，我会注意三件事

第一，上市。它告诉我代理实际提供什么、价格、交货时间以及我将收到什么。如果服务不是我想要的，即使很高的声誉评分也没有多大意义

然后是声誉。 TermiX 通过订单和争议结果在链上记录代理商的表现，为买家提供了一种查看过去表现的方法，而不是依赖代理商提出的索赔

不过，我不会将该分数视为保证，过去的表现是有用的背景，但它并不能保证下一个订单会顺利进行

质押是另一个信号，这就是 TermiX 与 Fiverr 等典型市场的不同之处

提供商可能有股份要求，但满足最低阈值并不等同于为特定订单锁定资金。并非每个订单都必然锁定提供商股份

我宁愿把这三者放在一起看：列表告诉我我要买什么，声誉给我一些历史，而赌注则表明是否有附加的经济承诺

它们都不能保证好的结果，但至少买家在选择代理商之前有更多的考虑

title:
Building an AI agent is one thing.

Making that agent useful beyond its own environment is a completely different challe
title_en:
Building an AI agent is one thing.

Making that agent useful beyond its own environment is a completely different challenge.

Think about a developer creating an AI agent for market research.

It can collect data, analyze trends, and generate reports. But what happens when it needs a specialized security audit or another service outside its capabilities?

This is where @termix_ai and its AACP infrastructure become interesting.

Through Agent Family, agents can connect with a marketplace where they can discover specialized services, request work, and coordinate with other agents.

But there's something bigger here.

Developers can bring these capabilities into their own applications instead of building separate systems for every interaction.

Service discovery, job coordination, payment settlement, and delivery verification can become part of a connected workflow.

That creates a different way to think about AI applications.

An agent doesn't need to know how to do everything. It needs a reliable way to find the right expertise when needed.

I believe this is an important step toward an AI economy where agents don't just generate outputs but also collaborate, exchange services, and create measurable value.

The future of AI might be less about one agent doing everything and more about many specialized agents working together.

That's the direction I'm watching with @termix_ai .

full_text_zh:
构建人工智能代理是一回事。

让代理在其自身环境之外发挥作用是一个完全不同的挑战。

想象一下开发人员为市场研究创建人工智能代理。

它可以收集数据、分析趋势并生成报告。但是，当它需要专门的安全审核或超出其能力范围的其他服务时会发生什么？

这就是 @termix_ai 及其 AACP 基础设施变得有趣的地方。

通过 Agent Family，代理可以与市场建立联系，在那里他们可以发现专业服务、请求工作并与其他代理进行协调。

但这里有更大的事情。

开发人员可以将这些功能引入自己的应用程序中，而不是为每次交互构建单独的系统。

服务发现、工作协调、支付结算和交付验证可以成为互联工作流程的一部分。

这创造了一种不同的思考人工智能应用的方式。

代理人不需要知道如何做所有事情。它需要一种可靠的方法来在需要时找到合适的专业知识。

我相信这是迈向人工智能经济的重要一步，在人工智能经济中，智能体不仅能产生产出，还能进行协作、交换服务并创造可衡量的价值。

人工智能的未来可能不再是一个代理完成所有事情，而是更多地由多个专业代理一起工作。

这就是我通过 @termix_ai 观察的方向。

title_en:
If you have money:

>Stop trying 900 shady nootropics
>Get a full gut health panel
>Get a full hormonal panel
>Fix your gut 
>Fix your hormones
>Get some wild cognitive benefits

If you can afford to do this and don't, you won't make it. 

The "nootropic" you actually need to have a great mood, focus and energy levels is called a healthy gut and hormones.

I’ve talked a lot about gut health recently, so let’s talk about hormones a bit.

Depression has repeatedly been linked to brain bioenergetic abnormalities such as:

-Lower nucleoside triphosphate in regions such as the basal ganglia
-Disrupted phosphocreatine (PCr) levels or tissue-specific PCr changes
-Lower intracellular magnesium
-Impaired high-energy phosphate metabolism or oxidative phosphorylation

Some models also show reduced extracellular ATP signaling (especially from astrocytes in the prefrontal cortex/hippocampus).

T3 has been used as an SSRI augmentation strategy in treatment-resistant depression in part because of its effects on cellular energy metabolism. 

T3 augmentation in SSRI non-responders showed a significant increase in total NTP and a compensatory decrease in PCr relative to non-responders. 

So it helps normalize brain bioenergetics.

Case study: a 32 yo woman on zoloft reported experiencing persistent fatigue, anxiety, cognitive impairment, and sleep disturbances.  

She expressed concerns that the medication had not alleviated her symptoms and may have exacerbated them. 

It turns out that she was just hypothyroid.

“Thyroid hormones inhibit GABA”.  

It’s true that thyroid hormones competitively inhibit the neuronal uptake of GABA.  

BUT thyroid hormone deficiency downregulates glutamic acid decarboxylase (GAD65/67).  

This is the primary enzyme responsible for converting glutamate into GABA. 

In this study, patients with hypothyroidism were found to have significantly decreased GABA+ levels in the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) compared to healthy controls.  

After six months of treatment with levothyroxine (L-T4), a significant increase in GABA+ concentrations was observed, leading to the normalization of GABA+ levels in the brain.

Besides this, if depression is associated with lower ATP and disrupted phosphocreatine levels, then it makes obvious sense why T3 would be used, since it increases cellular ATP and helps normalize the ATP/PCr ratio.  

On top, it also simultaneously increases beta-adrenergic receptor binding and alpha-2 autoreceptor binding.  

Besides these noradrenergic effects, it acts at a nuclear level to decrease the transcription of 5HT1a and 5HT1b serotonin autoreceptors.   

So it reduces feedback inhibition and boosts frontal cortex serotonin levels when paired with SSRIs.  

It also downregulates or blunts presynaptic alpha-2 autoreceptors and stimulates gene expression of BDNF.

Point being: if you have been battling depression for quite some time without much having changed in your life situation, get a hormonal panel done.

Your brain is far more sensitive to hormonal changes than you might think.

Heck, a small RCT even found that testosterone gel improved mood in men with low T who didn’t respond well to antidepressants and TRT has been used as an adjunct for quite some time.

Hormones and neurosteroids greatly modulate reward processing, interacting with neurotransmitters and CNS circuits.

Here are some common examples:

1. Testosterone: Testosterone binds via androgen receptors (ARs) in NAc, PFC and amygdala, enhancing dopamine synthesis, D1/D2 receptors and CB1 expression.

It:
-Boosts VTA-NAc dopamine, improving motivational anhedonia.
-Increases BDNF, supporting hippocampal/PFC plasticity.
-Enhances LTP via AR-mediated gene transcription.
-Protects dopaminergic neurons from elevated cytokine levels.

2. DHT:
-Enhances NAc dopamine and D2 density, supporting reward anticipation.
-Modulates GABA-A receptors, stabilizing amygdala responses.

3. Allopregnanolone:
-Enhances GABAergic inhibition, reducing amygdala hyperactivity.
-Increases BDNF, supporting reward learning.
-Reduces neuroinflammation.

4. DHEA:
-Increases dopamine in NAc/PFC.
-Boosts BDNF/CB1.
-Reduces cortisol.

5. Oxytocin:
-Increases VTA dopamine release, enhancing NAc reward signaling and motivational anhedonia.
-Promotes social reward salience.
-Dampens HPA axis activity, reducing cortisol and protecting CB1/D2 receptors from downregulation.

6. Triiodothyronine (T3):
-Enhances dopamine synthesis and receptor expression (D1/D2) in the VTA and NAc.
-Regulates mitochondrial function in neurons, supporting ATP production for dopamine release and synaptic plasticity.

To read more: https://t.co/D5v3QKxGHQ

full_text_zh:
如果你有钱：

>停止尝试 900 种可疑的促智药
>获得完整的肠道健康面板
>获得完整的荷尔蒙面板
>修复你的肠道
>修复你的荷尔蒙
>获得一些疯狂的认知益处

如果你有能力做到这一点但没有做到这一点，那么你就不会成功。

保持良好心情、注意力和精力水平所需的“促智”物质称为健康的肠道和激素。

我最近谈论了很多关于肠道健康的话题，所以让我们谈谈激素吧。

抑郁症一再与大脑生物能量异常有关，例如：

-降低基底神经节等区域的核苷三磷酸
-磷酸肌酸 (PCr) 水平中断或组织特异性 PCr 变化
-降低细胞内镁含量
-高能磷酸盐代谢或氧化磷酸化受损

一些模型还显示细胞外 ATP 信号传导减少（尤其是来自前额叶皮层/海马体的星形胶质细胞）。

T3 已被用作难治性抑郁症的 SSRI 增强策略，部分原因是它对细胞能量代谢的影响。

相对于无反应者，SSRI 无反应者的 T3 增强显示总 NTP 显着增加，PCr 代偿性下降。

因此它有助于使大脑生物能量正常化。

案例研究：一名服用左洛复的 32 岁女性报告出现持续疲劳、焦虑、认知障碍和睡眠障碍。

她担心药物并没有缓解她的症状，反而可能加剧症状。

事实证明，她只是甲状腺功能减退症。

“甲状腺激素抑制 GABA”。

甲状腺激素确实会竞争性抑制神经元对 GABA 的摄取。

但甲状腺激素缺乏会下调谷氨酸脱羧酶 (GAD65/67)。

这是负责将谷氨酸转化为 GABA 的主要酶。

在这项研究中，发现与健康对照相比，甲状腺功能减退症患者内侧前额皮质 (mPFC) 的 GABA+ 水平显着降低。

使用左旋甲状腺素 (L-T4) 治疗六个月后，观察到 GABA+ 浓度显着增加，导致大脑中 GABA+ 水平正常化。

除此之外，如果抑郁症与较低的 ATP 和破坏的磷酸肌酸水平有关，那么使用 T3 的原因就很明显了，因为它会增加细胞 ATP 并有助于使 ATP/PCr 比率正常化。

最重要的是，它还同时增加 β-肾上腺素能受体结合和 α-2 自身受体结合。

除了这些去甲肾上腺素能作用外，它还在核水平上发挥作用，减少 5HT1a 和 5HT1b 血清素自身受体的转录。

因此，与 SSRI 结合使用时，它可以减少反馈抑制并提高额叶皮质血清素水平。

它还下调或减弱突触前 α-2 自身受体并刺激 BDNF 的基因表达。

要点是：如果您已经与抑郁症作斗争相当长一段时间了，但生活状况没有太大变化，请完成荷尔蒙检查。

您的大脑对荷尔蒙变化的敏感程度比您想象的要高得多。

哎呀，一项小型随机对照试验甚至发现，睾酮凝胶可以改善对抗抑郁药物反应不佳的 T 值低的男性的情绪，而 TRT 已被用作辅助疗法相当长一段时间了。

激素和神经类固醇与神经递质和中枢神经系统回路相互作用，极大地调节奖励处理。

以下是一些常见示例：

1. 睾酮：睾酮通过 NAc、PFC 和杏仁核中的雄激素受体 (AR) 结合，增强多巴胺合成、D1/D2 受体和 CB1 表达。

它：
-增强 VTA-NAc 多巴胺，改善动机快感缺失。
-增加 BDNF，支持海马/PFC 可塑性。
-通过 AR 介导的基因转录增强 LTP。
-保护多巴胺能神经元免受细胞因子水平升高的影响。

2.双氢睾酮：
-增强 NAc 多巴胺和 D2 密度，支持奖励预期。
-调节 GABA-A 受体，稳定杏仁核反应。

3.异孕酮：
-增强 GABA 能抑制，减少杏仁核过度活跃。
-增加 BDNF，支持奖励学习。
-减少神经炎症。

4.脱氢表雄酮：

summary_zh:
、注意力和精力水平所需的“促智”物质称为健康的肠道和激素。

我最近谈论了很多关于肠道健康的话题，所以让我们谈谈激素吧。

抑郁症一再与大脑生物能量异常有关，例如：

-降低基底神经节等区域的核苷三磷酸
-磷酸肌酸 (PCr) 水平中断或组织特异性 PCr 变化
-降低细胞内镁含量
-高能磷酸盐代谢或氧化磷酸化受损

一些模型还显示细胞外 ATP 信号传导减少（尤其是来自前额叶皮层/海马体的星形胶质细胞）。

T3 已被用作难治性抑郁症的 SSRI 增强策略，部分原因是它对细胞能量代谢的影响。

相对于无反应者，SSRI 无反应者的 T3 增强显示总 NTP 显着增加，PCr 代偿性下降。

因此它有助于使大脑生物能量正常化。

案例研究：一名服用左洛复的 32 岁女性报告出现持续疲劳、焦虑、认知障碍和睡眠障碍。

她担心药物并没有缓解她的症状，反而可能加剧症状。

事实证明，她只是甲状腺功能减退症。

“甲状腺激素抑制 GABA”。

甲状腺激素确实会竞争性抑制神经元对 GABA 的摄取。

但甲状腺激素缺乏会下调谷氨酸脱羧酶 (GAD65/67)。

这是负责将谷氨酸转化为 GABA 的主要酶。

在这项研究中，发现与健康对照相比，甲状腺功能减退症患者内侧前额皮质 (mPFC) 的 GABA+ 水平显着降低。

使用左旋甲状腺素 (L-T4) 治疗六个月后，观察到 GABA+ 浓度显着增加，导致大脑中 GABA+ 水平正常化。

除此之外，如果抑郁症与较低的 ATP 和破坏的磷酸肌酸水平有关，那么使用 T3 的原因就很明显了，因为它会增加细胞 ATP 并有助于使 ATP/PCr 比率正常化。

最重要的是，它还同时增加 β-肾上腺素能受体结合和 α-2 自身受体结合。

除了这些去甲肾上腺素能作用外，它还在核水平上发挥作用，减少 5HT1a 和 5HT1b 血清素自身受体的转录。

因此，与 SSRI 结合使用时，它可以减少反馈抑制并提高额叶皮质血清素水平。

它还下调或减弱突触前 α-2 自身受体并刺激 BDNF 的基因表达。

要点是：如果您已经与抑郁症作斗争相当长一段时间了，但生活状况没有太大变化，请完成荷尔蒙检查。

您的大脑对荷尔蒙变化的敏感程度比您想象的要高得多。

哎呀，一项小型随机对照试验甚至发现，睾酮凝胶可以改善对抗抑郁药物反应不佳的 T 值低的男性的情绪，而 TRT 已被用作辅助疗法相当长一段时间了。

激素和神经类固醇与神经递质和中枢神经系统回路相互作用，极大地调节奖励处理。

以下是一些常见示例：

1. 睾酮：睾酮通过 NAc、PFC 和杏仁核中的雄激素受体 (AR) 结合，增强多巴胺合成、D1/D2 受体和 CB1 表达。

它：
-增强 VTA-NAc 多巴胺，改善动机快感缺失。
-增加 BDNF，支持海马/PFC 可塑性。
-通过 AR 介导的基因转录增强 LTP。
-保护多巴胺能神经元免受细胞因子水平升高的影响。

2.双氢睾酮：
-增强 NAc 多巴胺和 D2 密度，支持奖励预期。
-调节 GABA-A 受体，稳定杏仁核反应。

3.异孕酮：
-增强 GABA 能抑制，减少杏仁核过度活跃。
-增加 BDNF，支持奖励学习。
-减少神经炎症。

4.脱氢表雄酮：
-增加 NAc/PFC 中的多巴胺。
-增强 BDNF/CB1。
-减少皮质醇。

5.催产素：

title:
AI agents are getting better at doing the work as @termix_ai 

But the infrastructure around that work is still pretty f
title_en:
AI agents are getting better at doing the work as @termix_ai 

But the infrastructure around that work is still pretty fragmented.

And I think that's a bigger problem than most people realize.

Imagine building an AI application that handles research, data analysis, or security monitoring for users.

AACP isn't just powering an AI agent marketplace through agent family.

It's also exposing the infrastructure developers need to build agent commerce directly into their own applications.

APIs, SDKs, event streams, onchain identities, escrow, and delivery verification.

The interesting part is how these pieces connect.

Developers can build workflows where agents discover services, submit jobs, track their progress, and handle settlement through the protocol.

Instead of rebuilding the entire commerce system every time they launch a new agent.

And honestly, that's the kind of infrastructure I think the AI economy needs more of.

We're spending so much time making agents smarter that we sometimes forget they need reliable ways to operate as actual businesses.

For me, the next important step isn't just making AI capable of completing more tasks.

It's making those tasks verifiable, trackable, and economically useful.

Infrastructure that connects intelligence to real work might.

https://t.co/8ynfR7k2cR

full_text_zh:
AI 代理正在以 @termix_ai 的身份更好地完成工作

但围绕这项工作的基础设施仍然相当分散。

我认为这是一个比大多数人意识到的更大的问题。

想象一下构建一个人工智能应用程序来为用户处理研究、数据分析或安全监控。

AACP 不仅仅通过代理家族为人工智能代理市场提供动力。

它还公开了基础设施开发人员将代理商务直接构建到自己的应用程序中所需的基础设施。

API、SDK、事件流、链上身份、托管和交付验证。

有趣的部分是这些部分如何连接。

开发人员可以构建工作流程，让代理发现服务、提交作业、跟踪进度并通过协议处理结算。

而不是每次推出新代理时都重建整个商业系统。

老实说，我认为人工智能经济更需要这样的基础设施。

我们花费了大量的时间让代理商变得更加聪明，以至于我们有时忘记了他们需要可靠的方式来作为实际业务进行运营。

对我来说，下一个重要的步骤不仅仅是让人工智能能够完成更多任务。

它使这些任务变得可验证、可追踪且经济实用。

将智能与实际工作连接起来的基础设施可能会。

title: @BLKMDL3 @wholemars After we moved our tiny decoder into SRAM, we only have half a TRIP out of three on SoC B, for this
title_en:
@BLKMDL3 @wholemars After we moved our tiny decoder into SRAM, we only have half a TRIP out of three on SoC B, for this reality visualizer, so spent the compute as best we could. TRIP basically only handles 8-bit int and has to run softmax in emulation mode in 28 steps. 

AI5 is a gigantic improvement. Roughly 12X more compute.
title_zh:
在我们将我们的小解码器移动到SRAM之后，对于这个现实可视化器，我们在SoC B上只有三个TRIP中的一半，所以我们尽可能地使用了计算。TRIP基本上只处理8位int，并且必须在28步的仿真模式下运行softmax。

AI5是一个巨大的进

title:
@BLKMDL3 @wholemars In case anyone is curious:

We’ve had a ~pixel-perfect world model since last year, which is critica
title_en:
@BLKMDL3 @wholemars In case anyone is curious:

We’ve had a ~pixel-perfect world model since last year, which is critical for synthetic data generation. 

The (much) smaller version of that in the car is a conditional mean-flow model, based on the recent sequence of Tesla Universal Vision Encoder features, which are the same ones that are plugged into the 3B encoder model that produces the driving actions. 

We fork off from these UVE features, then run a separate ~1B diffusion model. This takes in the previous reality-view generation with added noise and then denoises it to the current visualization. 

It then produces a small video chunk (8 images at 36 fps, at the resolution of the UI screen). This work is done by 1/2 of a TRIP engine every UVE frame at 18 hz and is spread over 4 cycles. 

Currently, the latency is a bit high due to compute constraints, but we have ways to interleave newer UVE features along the diffusion transformer layers to cut roughly 35% of the latency.
full_text_en:
@BLKMDL3 @wholemars In case anyone is curious:

We’ve had a ~pixel-perfect world model since last year, which is critical for synthetic data generation. 

The (much) smaller version of that in the car is a conditional mean-flow model, based on the recent sequence of Tesla Universal Vision Encoder features, which are the same ones that are plugged into the 3B encoder model that produces the driving actions. 

We fork off from these UVE features, then run a separate ~1B diffusion model. This takes in the previous reality-view generation with added noise and then denoises it to the current visualization. 

It then produces a small video chunk (8 images at 36 fps, at the resolution of the UI screen). This work is done by 1/2 of a TRIP engine every UVE frame at 18 hz and is spread over 4 cycles. 

Currently, the latency is a bit high due to compute constraints, but we have ways to interleave newer UVE features along the diffusion transformer layers to cut roughly 35% of the latency.
full_text_zh:
@BLKMDL3 @wholemars 如果有人好奇：

自去年以来，我们已经有了一个像素完美的世界模型，这对于合成数据的生成至关重要。

汽车中的（小得多）版本是条件平均流模型，基于 Tesla 通用视觉编码器功能的最新序列，这些功能与插入到产生驾驶动作的 3B 编码器模型中的功能相同。

我们从这些 UVE 功能中分叉出来，然后运行一个单独的 ~1B 扩散模型。这会吸收先前生成的添加了噪声的现实视图，然后将其降噪到当前的可视化中。

然后它会生成一个小视频块（8 个图像，36 fps，UI 屏幕的分辨率）。这项工作由 TRIP 引擎在 18 Hz 的每个 UVE 帧上完成，并分布在 4 个周期内。

目前，由于计算限制，延迟有点高，但我们有办法沿着扩散转换器层交错更新的 UVE 功能，以减少大约 35% 的延迟。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 由Fast.ai创始人Jeremy Howard发起的llms.txt协议在发布两年后，已演变为AI代理读取产品文档事实的主流标准。该协议通过在网站根目录部署标准格式文件，允许Agent高效获取自动化操作指南，目前已被Neon等科技平台广泛集成。

elements_zh.what: 推广llms.txt协议，用于向AI代理分发指令
elements_zh.why: 解决非结构化数据在Agent任务执行中的索引与交互效率问题

elements_en.what: Promoting the llms.txt protocol for distributing instructions to AI agents
elements_en.why: To address indexing and interaction efficiency for unstructured data in Agent execution

ai_analysis.insight_zh: llms.txt作为AI时代的Robots.txt，其本质是构建人类知识与模型Agent之间的机器可读桥梁。通过标准化指令发布协议，企业大幅降低了Agent理解特定API生态的边际成本，这对于构建 Agentic Web 生态具备关键基础设施意义。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Acting as the 'robots.txt' for the AI era, llms.txt essentially builds a machine-readable bridge between human knowledge and model agents. By standardizing instruction distribution, enterprises significantly reduce the marginal cost for agents to understand specific API ecosystems, which is critical infrastructure for building the Agentic Web.

title: Cisco MCP Scanner. Scans MCP servers and tools for security findings. https://t.co/fUScOpUXOR
title_en: Cisco MCP Scanner. Scans MCP servers and tools for security findings. https://t.co/fUScOpUXOR
title_zh: MCP Scanner发布，解决AI智能体工具链安全审查难题
author: @MirzaJhanzaib
author_role: AI 先锋观察者
summary_en: The MCP Scanner targets MCP servers by performing structural parsing and interprocedural dataflow analysis to track inputs reaching sensitive operations. It integrates static analysis with LLM reasoning to detect behavioral mismatches, surfacing malicious activity that traditional pattern-based scanners miss.
summary_zh: 开源MCP扫描器通过结合静态程序分析与LLM语义理解，识别AI工具行为与宣称意图间的不一致，防御恶意数据窃取。
full_text_zh: 思科 MCP 扫描仪。扫描 MCP 服务器和工具以获取安全结果。
full_text_en: Cisco MCP Scanner. Scans MCP servers and tools for security findings. https://t.co/fUScOpUXOR

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 该扫描器针对模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，通过解析代码结构及执行跨函数数据流分析，追踪参数从输入到敏感操作（如网络请求）的全链路。它利用静态分析的精度配合大模型的语境理解，判定工具行为是否偏离预期，从而识别掩藏在合法接口下的恶意行为。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: The MCP Scanner targets MCP servers by performing structural parsing and interprocedural dataflow analysis to track inputs reaching sensitive operations. It integrates static analysis with LLM reasoning to detect behavioral mismatches, surfacing malicious activity that traditional pattern-based scanners miss.

elements_zh.where: MCP（模型上下文协议）开发环境
elements_zh.what: 发布开源扫描器以检测工具行为与意图的语义偏离
elements_zh.why: 防范AI智能体工具被恶意利用窃取敏感数据

elements_en.what: Open-source scanner for MCP servers
elements_en.why: Mitigate security risks where tools exfiltrate data under benign facades

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 单纯依赖大模型自身的对齐能力无法杜绝智能体层面的逻辑漏洞，此方案标志着AI基础设施安全正从简单的输入过滤转向基于行为语义的深度审计。未来，具备跨组件行为编排分析能力的静态扫描工具，将成为企业部署AI智能体时的强制性中间件。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Relying solely on LLM alignment is insufficient to prevent logical exploits in agentic workflows, signaling a shift toward semantic-based behavioral auditing. Tools capable of cross-component behavioral analysis will become mandatory middleware for enterprise agent deployment.

ai_analysis.digest_en: The MCP Scanner targets MCP servers by performing structural parsing and interprocedural dataflow analysis to track inputs reaching sensitive operations. title:
The first block tells a bigger story about @Hypesium than a simple speed benchmark.

Elysium operates with 100ms block i
title_en:
The first block tells a bigger story about @Hypesium than a simple speed benchmark.

Elysium operates with 100ms block intervals and no public mempool. That changes the way applications need to approach transaction preparation. In a conventional workflow, several operations may happen after an opportunity appears. On Elysium, moving that work earlier becomes an important architectural decision.

Hypesium describes a preparation-first execution model:

➜ The transaction route is constructed in advance.
➜ Calldata is prepared before the pool event.
➜ Gas information is refreshed.
➜ Wallet nonce state is maintained.
➜ The pool creation log triggers the submission process.

The documented hot path targets under 5ms, with four communication lanes used for simultaneous submission.

What I find interesting is the relationship between block timing and software architecture. A 100ms block interval doesn't simply reward faster computers. It also rewards systems that minimize the amount of work left for the final moment.

There is still a distinction between transaction submission, block inclusion and final confirmation. These should never be treated as identical performance measurements.

@Hypesium's architecture offers an interesting case study in moving computation away from a time-sensitive execution window.

The real engineering question is not just how quickly a system reacts, but how much preparation it completes before there is anything to react to.

full_text_zh:
第一个块讲述了关于 @Hypesium 的更大故事，而不是简单的速度基准。

Elysium 以 100 毫秒的区块间隔运行，没有公共内存池。这改变了应用程序处理事务准备的方式。在传统的工作流程中，机会出现后可能会发生多个操作。在 Elysium 上，提前移动该工作成为一个重要的架构决策。

Hypesium 描述了一种准备优先的执行模型：

➜ 交易路径是提前构建的。
➜ Calldata 在池事件之前准备好。
➜ 气体信息被刷新。
➜ 维持钱包随机数状态。
➜ 池创建日志触发提交过程。

记录的热路径目标为 5 毫秒以下，并使用四个通信通道同时提交。

我发现有趣的是块时序和软件架构之间的关系。 100 毫秒的区块间隔不仅仅奖励更快的计算机。它还奖励那些最大限度地减少最后时刻剩余工作量的系统。

交易提交、区块包含和最终确认之间仍然存在区别。这些绝不应该被视为相同的性能测量。

@Hypesium 的架构提供了一个有趣的案例研究，将计算从时间敏感的执行窗口中移开。

真正的工程问题不仅仅是系统的反应速度有多快，而是在做出反应之前它完成了多少准备工作。

What is the reason behind GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra performing so poorly? How are you planning to fix this? What do the timeline and roadmap look like? How do you currently view the competition from Google, and what steps do you intend to take? 

I think this would be helpful for everyone involved. Communication with the community used to be better than it is now.

title:
THE WINNER OF ANTHROPIC'S OFFICIAL HACKATHON HAS PUBLISHED HIS CLAUDE CODE SETUP AND IT'S PURE GOLD

68 subagents, 286 s
title_en:
THE WINNER OF ANTHROPIC'S OFFICIAL HACKATHON HAS PUBLISHED HIS CLAUDE CODE SETUP AND IT'S PURE GOLD

68 subagents, 286 skills, 94 commands, MIT license.

ECC turns Claude Code into a full engineering team.

The plan comes before the code.

The failing test comes before the fix.

Every change is reviewed by a context that hasn't seen how it was written.

→ Planning: you give it a sentence and approve the plan before a single line exists  
→ Review: a different reviewer per language that reads your diff from scratch  
→ Build fixes: a fixer per toolchain, including PyTorch and CUDA  
→ Security: full OWASP sweep and injection scanning in the agent config  
→ Architecture: detects design errors when they're still cheap, before migration  
→ Domain: databases, ML pipelines, E2E tests, and documentation

The security part is what almost nobody sets up.

An external OWASP audit costs four figures and a week. This one is ready before you eat.

The skills cover testing, Python, Go, Rust, Django, Next.js, Docker, and CI/CD.

That said, don't activate all 286 at once or you'll end up with a config worse than the one you had.

This is how it integrates well:

→ Make a fork and read the README before copying anything  
→ Start only with the planning agent and the rules pack for your main language  
→ Copy to your .claude folder only the agents and skills you're going to use this week  
→ Add the code reviewer and the security one afterward, as they yield the most  
→ Test it first on a small repo, not in production  
→ If something's extra, cut it. If you miss something, add just one more piece

The rule is simple: if you don't know what an agent is for, you don't need it yet.

Whoever integrates it well this weekend will spend the next quarter reviewing work instead of writing it.

Save this post, you'll thank me 🔖

full_text_zh:
ANTHROPIC 官方黑客马拉松的获胜者已经发布了他的 Claude Code 设置，并且它是纯金的

68 个子代理、286 种技能、94 条命令、MIT 许可证。

ECC 将 Claude Code 打造为一支完整的工程团队。

计划先于代码。

失败的测试先于修复。

每个更改都会由尚未了解其编写方式的上下文进行审查。

→ 规划：你给它一个句子并在一行出现之前批准该计划
→ 审阅：每种语言都有不同的审阅者，从头开始读取您的差异
→ 构建修复：每个工具链都有一个修复程序，包括 PyTorch 和 CUDA
→ 安全性：代理配置中的完整 OWASP 扫描和注入扫描
→ 架构：在迁移之前检测设计错误，当它们仍然便宜时
→ 领域：数据库、ML 管道、E2E 测试和文档

安全部分几乎没有人设置。

外部 OWASP 审核的费用为四位数和一周。这个在你吃之前已经准备好了。

这些技能涵盖测试、Python、Go、Rust、Django、Next.js、Docker 和 CI/CD。

也就是说，不要一次激活所有 286 个，否则您最终会得到一个比您原来的配置更糟糕的配置。

这是它很好地集成的方式：

→ 在复制任何内容之前创建一个 fork 并阅读 README
→ 仅从规划代理和您的主要语言的规则包开始
→ 仅将本周要使用的代理和技能复制到您的 .claude 文件夹
→ 随后添加代码审查人员和安全人员，因为它们产出最多
→ 首先在一个小型仓库上进行测试，而不是在生产环境中进行测试
→ 如果有多余的东西，就把它剪掉。如果您遗漏了什么，请再添加一件

规则很简单：如果您不知道代理的用途，那么您还不需要它。

谁在这个周末整合得好，谁就会在下个季度回顾工作而不是编写工作。

author: @InfoQ
author_role: AI 先锋观察者
summary_en: Google's Agent Compute Engine is a managed service that decouples AI agent execution from credential management via microVMs. It employs copy-on-write memory sharing and fast checkpointing, keeping secrets in an external gateway while maintaining secure, persistent workspaces.
summary_zh: 谷歌推出的Agent Compute Engine利用微型虚拟机（microVM）与写时复制内存技术，提供高效、安全的智能体运行环境。
full_text_zh: Google 宣布推出用于安全 AI 代理执行的代理计算引擎 作者：Renato Losio
full_text_en: Google Announces Agent Compute Engine for Secure AI Agent Execution https://t.co/Cfl6t3eYzP by Renato Losio

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 谷歌发布的Agent Compute Engine是一项托管服务，通过微型虚拟机将智能体执行与底层凭据管理分离。该架构采用写时复制内存共享和快速检查点/恢复机制，确保智能体在隔离沙箱中运行的同时，将API密钥与敏感凭据留在外部网关，从而实现高可扩展性与安全性。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Google's Agent Compute Engine is a managed service that decouples AI agent execution from credential management via microVMs. It employs copy-on-write memory sharing and fast checkpointing, keeping secrets in an external gateway while maintaining secure, persistent workspaces.

elements_zh.who: 谷歌基础设施团队（工程师：Ramanathan Venkatapathy, Rohit Jnagal）
elements_zh.where: 企业级AI智能体开发与部署环境
elements_zh.what: 发布Agent Compute Engine服务，通过微型虚拟机隔离执行
elements_zh.why: 解决智能体在执行任务时面临的凭据安全、资源成本与状态持久化挑战

elements_en.who: Google Infrastructure Team (Ramanathan Venkatapathy, Rohit Jnagal)
elements_en.what: Launch of Agent Compute Engine
elements_en.why: Address credential security, cost, and state persistence for agent execution

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 将智能体的执行环境（hands）与编排控制中心（brain）解耦，是防范供应链攻击的关键架构范式。这种确定性的审计轨迹与隔离机制，是目前从实验性智能体迈向高可靠生产级应用的核心基石。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Decoupling agent execution (hands) from the orchestration harness (brain) is the critical architectural paradigm to mitigate supply chain attacks. This deterministic audit trail and isolation mechanism are the foundations for moving agents from experimentation to production-grade reliability.

title:
Ever notice how an ai agent can follow your instructions a little too literally.

https://t.co/nzjQQj85UT

That is why i
title_en:
Ever notice how an ai agent can follow your instructions a little too literally.

https://t.co/nzjQQj85UT

That is why i have been looking at how @FensoryApp handles the part that actually matters imo.

The limits are not just something you tell the agent in chat.

You set the markets it can trade the max size for each order and those rules sit on the account.

Then every order gets checked before it reaches hyperliquid.

So if the limit is $100 the agent can not suddenly decide $101 is fine lol.

The interesting part for me is that the agent still gets room to make its own decisions.

It can choose the strategy and execute trades but the account rules stay outside its control.

One thing i did probably add though.

A per order cap does not really tell you how much damage can happen across a whole day.

I did want a daily loss limit too especially if the strategy keeps running while i am not watching.

Because giving an agent permission to trade is one thing.

Deciding exactly how far that permission goes is another.

If you were setting up an agent on @FensoryApp would you care more about a max order size or a daily loss limit?

full_text_zh:
有没有注意到人工智能代理是如何过于字面地遵循你的指令的。

这就是为什么我一直在研究 @FensoryApp 如何处理在我看来真正重要的部分。

这些限制不仅仅是您在聊天中告诉客服人员的事情。

您可以设置每个订单可以交易的最大规模的市场，并且这些规则位于帐户中。

然后，每个订单在达到超流动性之前都会受到检查。

因此，如果限额为 100 美元，代理不能突然决定 101 美元就可以了，哈哈。

对我来说有趣的是，代理仍然有空间做出自己的决定。

它可以选择策略并执行交易，但账户规则不受其控制。

不过我可能添加了一件事。

每个订单的上限并不能真正告诉您一整天可能会发生多少损坏。

我确实也想要每日损失限制，特别是如果该策略在我不观看时继续运行。

因为给予代理人交易许可是一回事。

确切地决定该许可的范围是另一回事。

如果您在 @FensoryApp 上设置代理，您会更关心最大订单大小还是每日损失限制？

An autonomous AI agent still depending on someone else's cloud subscription feels like a missing piece.

@Acurast has an interesting approach through its Deploy Agent.

Instead of requiring a developer account or an $ACU balance, an agent can pay for compute using USDC on Base through x402.

➛ Request compute through the Deploy Agent

The next question is whether the execution cost and reliability can compete with conventional hosting.

title:
VIBE CODING DIDN'T CREATE A GENERATION OF BUILDERS. IT CREATED A GENERATION OF STARTERS.

MIT just published the most un
title_en:
VIBE CODING DIDN'T CREATE A GENERATION OF BUILDERS. IT CREATED A GENERATION OF STARTERS.

MIT just published the most uncomfortable paper on AI coding.

They tracked every new app on the App Store, Play Store and Chrome Web Store after coding agents showed up.

Devs using autonomous agents wrote 25.5x more code.

Commits up 240%.

Actual releases?

Up 30%.

It gets worse.

After adopting tools like Claude Code, devs wrote 7x more lines and deleted 12.2x more.

Repos abandoned within 30 days went from 60% to 69%.

New apps launching roughly DOUBLED since early 2025.

User engagement didn't move.

Twice as many apps.

Same number of people using them.

I felt this one personally.

I shipped three "projects" last month with Claude Code.

Pretty sure zero humans used any of them.

Here's my take.

AI didn't make people better builders.

It made starting so cheap that finishing stopped meaning anything.

Writing code was never the bottleneck.

Taste was.

Reviewing was.

Building something people actually want was.

And no model is fixing that for you.

title: HOLY F*CK... MIT students made $26 MILLION in ONE live round at a Citadel & Jane Street contest... from a single Python
title_en:
HOLY F*CK... MIT students made $26 MILLION in ONE live round at a Citadel & Jane Street contest... from a single Python notebook that's on GitHub for free

3rd place, one notebook, the model Goldman Sachs built in 1990: Black-Litterman. no deep learning, no GPUs, just MATH

i ran their exact rule on 9 real stocks since October & let Claude Fable 5.2 make every call: the paper book is up 2.1% while SPY dropped 7.5%

first understand how this works:

> every team got the same stocks, live prices & 3 analysts' price predictions, then the contest scored the portfolios live

> Black-Litterman starts from what the market already holds & tilts toward the analysts, only as far as the math trusts them

> a Sharpe gate keeps a new portfolio only when it beats the current one, & the bot finished the live round $26 MILLION up

how to run it with Claude Code:

1. tell Claude Code to clone https://t.co/dhTzZnC1fI & open case3.ipynb

title_en:
🚨ALERT: U.S. banks are taking a HANDS-OFF approach to outside AI agents’ mistakes.

If you give an AI agent access to your account and it sends money to the wrong person, your bank may treat the payment as one you approved. 

And, you could be on the hook.

Here's what banks recently included in their terms:

- Citi says it will treat transfers as yours even if the agent ignores your instructions or someone uses a password the agent leaked.

- PNC requires bank-approved connections and generally bars outside agents from paying bills or moving money.

- Chase lets you share account data through approved connections but bars you from giving an outside AI tool your bank login.

- Bank of America advised customers to approve transfers themselves before an AI tool sends money, per TechCrunch.

- Schwab blocked AI tools that tried to move customers’ money without permission.

- Wells Fargo says that starting Nov. 24, it will treat an agent’s transfers as yours if you gave it access.

Yet, you can still dispute a transfer. Federal law may protect you depending on who sent the money and how they got access.

full_text_zh:
🚨警告：美国银行正在对外部人工智能代理的错误采取不干涉的态度。

如果您允许 AI 代理访问您的账户，而该代理将资金发送给错误的人，您的银行可能会将这笔付款视为您批准的付款。

而且，你可能会陷入困境。

以下是银行最近在其条款中包含的内容：

- 花旗表示，即使代理无视您的指示或有人使用代理泄露的密码，它也会将转账视为您的转账。

- PNC 需要银行批准的连接，并且通常禁止外部代理支付账单或转移资金。

- 大通银行允许您通过批准的连接共享帐户数据，但禁止您向外部人工智能工具提供您的银行登录信息。

- 据 TechCrunch 报道，美国银行建议客户在人工智能工具汇款之前自行批准转账。

- 施瓦布阻止了试图未经许可转移客户资金的人工智能工具。

- 富国银行表示，从 11 月 24 日开始，如果您授予代理访问权限，它将把代理的转账视为您的转账。

然而，您仍然可以对转移提出异议。联邦法律可能会保护您，具体取决于汇款人以及他们如何获取资金。

elements_en.why: To validate market oversupply and the trend of commoditized infrastructure

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 推理服务市场已演变为高度碎片化的红海，单纯提供API接入的商业壁垒近乎消失。未来市场的核心博弈将从“接入数量”转向围绕低延迟转发、异构芯片调度优化及差异化模型微调能力的垂直整合竞争。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The inference market has evolved into a highly fragmented red ocean where the barrier to entry for API-only providers has essentially evaporated. Future competition will pivot from mere access aggregation to vertical integration, emphasizing low-latency routing, heterogeneous chip orchestration, and specialized fine-tuning capabilities.
